analysis: The PR is documentation-only. In docs/reference/configuration.md it adds a "Scheduler-prefill benchmark prompts" subsection (head lines ~126-139) under the Provider CLI section. It documents a CLI-only `benchmark --scheduler-prefill --prefill-fixed-prompt` flag, which has no environment or provider.toml key and is rejected in other benchmark modes. It also notes that scheduler prefill applies the existing MLXMemoryGuard limits before direct model loading. The documentation states that the flag does not change the prefill stripe or enable prefix caching. No code, authorization, attestation, encryption, endpoint or configuration-passthrough behavior changes in the supplied evidence. The text does not add any LaunchAgent passthrough variable, so the daemon trust boundary (TB-002/TB-003/TB-011) is unaffected. The prefix-cache threat (T-041) is not touched, because the doc says the fixed prompt does not enable caching. Benchmark runs with fixed repeated prompts are local diagnostics and do not process consumer data (A-001). Remaining unverified items: the described benchmark and MLXMemoryGuard source changes are not in this batch, so the accuracy of the claims (for example that the flag has no effect on the cache or the prefill stripe) cannot be confirmed here. The documentation is not evidence of any regression.
